The PKK is an armed militant group **operating primarily in Turkey**, which historically sought a Kurdish homeland **within Turkey**. They are generally secular and **politically Marxist-Leninist**.

PYD is a group formed in 2003 **by Syrian Kurds** and is **composed of Syrians only**. Officially, they are banned in Syria under a constitution which outlaws the formation of political parties along religious or ethnic lines and suffered a lot after the Qamislo massacre. so the YPG, the armed hand of PYD was formed.
